name: Discord
description: Reads messages in the channels you choose and lets the autopilot answer as your bot.
guide: Open the [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications) and press **New Application**. Give it a name, for example the name of your project.
In the left menu open **Bot**. Press **Reset Token**, copy the token and paste it below. Anyone with this token can act as your bot, so keep it private.
Still on the **Bot** page, scroll to **Privileged Gateway Intents** and switch on **Message Content Intent**. Without it the bot sees empty messages. Save.
Paste the token below and press **Test connection**. The result shows an **invite link**. Open it, choose your server and press **Authorize**.
Come back, press **Reload** on the channel list and tick the channels the autopilot should listen to.

setup.label: Bot token
setup.help: From the Bot page of your application in the Developer Portal.

setup.label: Channels to listen to
setup.help: The autopilot only reacts to new messages in these channels. Needs the bot invited to your server first.
